# iTelematics®

> iTelematics Software Private Limited (Bangalore, India) works on applied Satellite Engineering: practical projects in spacecraft solar energy, batteries, the electrical power system (EPS), sensors, telemetry and satellite health, shaped by startup opportunities, industry requirements and collaborative research. Its flagship research platform is Satellite Energy & Telemetry Intelligence, built around one question: can the satellite generate, store and manage sufficient energy to safely accomplish its mission?

Research results are labelled by maturity (Concept, Research, Simulation, Prototype, Experimental, Validated, Planned). Nothing on the site is flight-qualified, and reference values are simulated, not flight data.

## Main pages

- [Satellite Engineering](https://itelematics.com/satellite-engineering): the spacecraft as one connected system: mission and orbit, power, avionics, ADCS, communications, payload, thermal and ground
- [Research Lab](https://itelematics.com/research-lab): Satellite Engineering Research Lab: practical research in satellite electrical power systems, battery energy storage, telemetry, spacecraft health, physics-based modelling and digital twin engineering; includes the Space Digital Twin (four interactive 3D experiences of a satellite, an orbital constellation, a spacecraft and a space station, built on physics-based and mathematical models driven by simulated data; AI health monitoring and cybersecurity are planned) and the flagship research, Satellite Energy & Telemetry Intelligence: orbit, energy, telemetry, fault scenarios, equations and engineering evidence with maturity labels
- [Engineering Ecosystem](https://itelematics.com/partners): Gamyaa AeroSystems, APEX Rocket Systems (proposed, concept stage), UFlight™ (aerospace health and usage monitoring), iFab Innovations (engineering & innovation ecosystem; no partnership claimed), EV Society™ and EV.ENGINEER™, each relationship described as it stands
- [Consultancy & Services](https://itelematics.com/consultancy): engineering consultancy, workshops and resources offered alongside the research
- [Contact](https://itelematics.com/contact): opens an email draft to info@iTelematics.com for Research Lab, research, academic, industry, consultancy and investment enquiries

## Engineering resources

- [Satellite Engineering reference](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering): spacecraft architecture on EV.ENGINEER™ around a 6U Earth-observation reference mission
- [Interactive 3D Satellite](https://aerospace.ev.engineer/space/satellite-engineering/interactive-3d): interactive model of satellite subsystems
